svg.title: Tree Dude extraction pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Customer notes enter the API route coordinator. The coordinator runs an independent option-price sidecar and an OpenAI extraction path governed by a prompt and strict draft schema. The draft adapter passes model facts to the deterministic AlphaJSON normalizer. Sidecar pricing is then reconciled before validation decides blockers, warnings, follow-ups, and PDF readiness. Provider failures bypass the model and use the same deterministic normalization, reconciliation, and validation stages.
